senses.gloss: to be thick, swell; to run over.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Parah 6:4">Par. VI, 4</cite> <he>כדי שׁיַעַבְרוּ המים וכ׳</he> that the water may overflow into a vessel; a. e.—
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:12">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> <he>שאני עוֹבֵר</he>, v. <cite ref="P00070"><he>עֶבְרָה</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: (cmp. סְגֵי I a. II) to pass, to cross.
units: Tosef. Sot. VIII, 1; Sot. 33ᵇ כיצד עָבְרוּ ישראל את וכ׳ in what manner did the Israelites cross the Jordan? Cant. R. to V, 13 עוֹבֵר הוא וחוזר וכ׳ he goes over his studies once and again &c.; a. fr.—ע׳ את הדין to cross the line of justice, to be too severe.
<cite ref="Mishnah Middot 2:2">Midd. II, 2</cite> <he>כאילו עברו עליו וכ׳</he> as if they had treated him too severely (arbitrarily).

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 30">Ex. R. s. 30</cite> <he>כשם שאני יכול לַעֲבוֹר … ואני איני מַעֲבִיר וכ׳</he> as I (the Lord) have power to treat the nations with rigor, but refrain from doing so, so shall you not go beyond the line of justice.
Ib. עִיבְּרָה את הדין (Pi.); a. e.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:5:1">Cant. R. to V, 5</cite> (play on <he>מור עובר</he>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:5:1">ib.</cite>) <he>מר עובר ע׳ על מררי</he> the bitterness passes away, he (the Lord) passes over my bitterness (sin).

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 17a:14">R. Hash. 17ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Micah 7:18">Mic. VII, 18</cite>) <he>למי נושא עון למי שעובר על פשע</he> whose iniquity does he pardon? the iniquity of him who forgives (his neighbor’s) transgression; a. e.
<cite ref="Yoma 86b">Yoma 86ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>כיון שע׳ אדם עבירה ושנה וכ׳</he> as soon as a man has committed a sin and repeated it, it becomes to him a permitted act.
<cite ref="Yoma 86a:7">Ib. 86ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>ע׳ על עשה</he> when one has transgressed a positive law (committed a sin of omission).
<cite ref="Yoma 86a:7">Ib.</cite> <he>ע׳ על כריתות וכ׳</he> when one has committed sins punishable with extinction or death by a court.
<cite ref="Eruvin 100a">Erub. 100ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>עובר על בל וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="B00800"><he>בַּל</he></cite>.
Keth. VII, 6 העוֹבֶרֶת על דת וכ׳ if a wife offends against Mosaic or Jewish customs, v. דַּת; Y. ib. VII, 31ᶜ top נשים המְעַבְּרוֹת על הדת (Pi.); a. v. fr.

Pes. 7ᵇ כל המצות מברך עליהן עובר לעשייתן in the performance of all religious ceremonies one must say the benediction over them before doing them; מאי משמע דהאי עובר לישנא דאקדומי היא what evidence is there that this ‘ober has the meaning of precedence? Answ. by ref. to ויעבר (II Sam. XVIII, 23) ‘and he arrived before the Cushite’.

senses.gloss: to pass by, go away, be removed.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 3:1">Pes. III, 1</cite> <he>אלו עוֹבְרִין בפסח</he> the following things must pass away (their use must be suspended) during Passover.
<cite ref="Beitzah 26a">Bets. 26ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מום עובר</he> a transitory blemish, opp. <he>קבוע</he>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 26a:17">Ber. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ יומו בטל קרבנו</he> when its day is passed, the sacrifice of the day is void.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 2:2">Pes. II, 2</cite> <he>חמץ … שע׳ עליו הפסח</he> leavened matter … over which Passover has passed (which had been in the house during Passover).

<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 9:3">Ber. IX, 3</cite> <he>הצועק לַשֶּׁעָבַר וכ׳</he> praying for what is passed (decided) is a vain prayer, e.g. if one’s wife is with child, and one prays, may it be the will of God that my wife bear a male child; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 2:2:13">Y. Taan. II, 65ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>נותן הודייה לשעבר וצועק וכ׳</he> one gives thanks for what is passed, and prays for what is to come.

<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 7:7">Gitt. VII, 7</cite> <he>כל זמן שאֱעֶבוֹר מכנגד פניך וכ׳</he> as soon as I shall have been out of thy sight for thirty days; <cite ref="Tosefta Gittin 7:10">Tosef. ib. VII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Gittin 5:10">V</cite>), 10.
<cite ref="Ketubot 17a:9">Keth. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ מלפני כלה</he> he passed aside to make room for a bridal procession.

<cite ref="Yoma 66a">Yoma 66ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>חטאת שעָבְרָה שנתה</he> a sin-offering whose year is passed (that is older than one year); <cite ref="Temurah 22a:24">Tem. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>שעִיבְּרָה שנתה</he> (Pi.) whose year is completed (v. infra).

<cite ref="Temurah 21b:22">Ib. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>בכור שעברה שנתו</he> a first-born animal older than one year; <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 5b">R. Hash. 5ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Zevachim 29a:14">Zeb. 29ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>שעיברה</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 3:6">Tosef. Snh. III, 6</cite> <he>בכור שעיברה זמנו</he> ed. Zuck. (read with Var.: <he>שעבר</he>).
Keth. 87ᵃ על שֶׁעָ׳ as regards the past, v. עָתִיד; a. v. fr.—לַשֶּׁעָ׳ in former days.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 47:1">Gen. R. s. 47</cite>, opp. <cite ref="P00754"><he>עַכְשָׁיו</he></cite>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 7:23">Tosef. Sabb. VII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 8:23">VIII</cite>), 23 [read:] <he>מַעֲבִירִין על גבי העין בשבת</he> you are permitted to stroke a sore eye on the Sabbath; Y. ib. XIV, 14ᶜ bot. <he>מעבירין על העין</he>. Ib. <he>הֶעֱבִירוּ עליו כלים</he> they passed garments over it.

senses.gloss: to cause to pass; to remove, displace.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 17a:9">Keth. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>מַעֲבִירִין את המת מלפני כלה וכ׳</he> a funeral procession is made to make way for a bridal procession, and both of them for the king, v. supra.

<cite ref="Gittin 57b:18">Gitt. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>שאין אנו מעבירין אותו באל אחר</he> that we shall never displace him for another god; <he>שאין מַעֲבִיר אותנו וכ׳</he> that he will never displace us for another nation.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 30">Ex. R. s. 30</cite> <he>כאילו היא מעביר איקינין וכ׳</he> as if he removed (defaced) the king’s portrait; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to go beyond. Ib. איני מעביר וכ׳, v. supra. Ib. הבריות מעבירין על הדין וכ׳ men go beyond the line of justice (are treacherous, cruel), and they are punished; a. e.
to skip over; to forego, postpone.—ה׳ על מדותיו, v. מִדָּה.—
units: <cite ref="Yoma 33a">Yoma 33ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 58b">58ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>אין מעבירין על המצות</he> you must not forego the occasion for performing a religious act.
<cite ref="Eruvin 64b:19">Erub. 64ᵇ</cite> <he>אין מעבירין על האוכלין</he> you must not pass by eatables (and let them lie in the street); <cite ref="Bava Metzia 23a">B. Mets. 23ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 17a:13">R. Hash. 17ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Micah 7:18">Mic. VII, 18</cite>) <he>מעביר ראשון ראשין וכך היא המדה</he> (Ms. M. <he>על ראשון וכ׳</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) he pardons one sin after the other (before they are put on the scale), and such is the divine dealing.
<cite ref="Micah 7:18">Ib.</cite> <he>מעבירין לו על כל פשעיו</he> all his transgressions are pardoned; a. fr.
<cite ref="Eruvin 41b:12">Erub. 41ᵇ</cite> <he>שלשה דברים מעבירין … על וכ׳</he> three things make a man disregard his own sense (of right) and the sense of his Maker; a. e.
<cite ref="Temurah 22a:23">Tem. 22ᵃ</cite>, a. e., v. supra.

senses.gloss: to transgress repeatedly. Y. Keth. VII, 31ᶜ top, v. supra.
to go beyond. Ex. R. l. c. עיברה את הדין, v. supra. [Tosef. B. Kam. VI, 22 שעיברה הדליקה עד, read with Y. ib. VII, 5ᶜ. שעברה … את.]

units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 31b:6">Kidd. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>כי עִבַּרְתּוֹ אמו וכ׳</he> while his mother was pregnant with him, his father died.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 10:1">Tosef. B. Kam. X, 1</cite> <he>ועִיבְּרָה אצלו</he> (<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 9:1">B. Kam. IX, 1</cite> <he>ונִתְעַבְּרָה</he>) and the cow became pregnant while she was in his possession.
Ḥull. 58ᵃ; a. fr.—Part. pass. f. מְעוּבֶּרֶת; pl. מְעוּבָּרוֹת pregnant.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 16:1">Yeb. XVI, 1</cite>.
<cite ref="Yevamot 36b:8">Ib. 36ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>מע׳ חבירו</he> a woman who is with child of another man (divorced or widowed during pregnancy).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 85:10">Gen. R. s. 85</cite> <he>מלכים אני מע׳ גואלים אני מע׳</he> I am pregnant with kings, with redeemers (kings and redeemers are destined to be of my offspring).
Yeb. III, 10; a. fr.—4) (v. עִיבּוּר) to extend the city limits, for the purpose of defining Sabbath distances, in cases of buildings projecting beyond the city lines (outskirts).

Erub. V, 1 כיצד מְעַבְּרִין וכ׳ (v. אָבַר), defined ib. 53ᵃ; Y. ib. V, beg. 22ᵇ; Y. Ber. VII, 12ᶜ top כאשה עוברה like a pregnant woman; Tosef. Ber. VI (V), 1; a. e.—6) to complement, add to, esp. to intercalate a month, (second Adar); proclaim a leap year; to complement a month (v. מָלֵא) by assigning to it an additional day (thirty days).
<cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 2:1">Tosef. Snh. II, 1</cite> <he>שנים אומרים צריכה לְעַבֵּר</he> if two judges say, it is necessary to intercalate a month.

<cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 2:2">Ib. 2</cite> <he>על שלשה סימנים מעברין וכ׳</he> on three indications the intercalation is decided; <he>על שנים מעברין וכ׳</he> when two of them exist, the intercalation is decreed.

<cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 2:2">Ib.</cite> <he>ואם עִיבְּרוּהָ הרי זו מעוברת</he> but if they proclaimed it a leap-year, it remains a leap-year; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְעוּבָּר</he>; f. <he>מְעוּבֶּרֶת</he>.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 19b:5">R. Hash. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>אלול מע׳</he> an Elul of thirty days.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 11b:8">Snh. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>אינה מע׳</he> the year is not a leap-year (the declared intercalation is invalid); a. fr.

Sifré Num. 135 (expl. ויתעבר, Deut. III, 26) כאדם שאומר נ׳ בי פלוני נתמלא וכ׳ as a man says, that man (became full) got wroth with me, meaning, he was filled with wrath against me; Yalk. Deut. 818; Sifré Deut. 29 כאשה שאינה יכולה לשוח מפני עוברה (swelled,) like a woman that cannot bend down on account of the child she is pregnant with; v. עֶבְרָה.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 45">Gen. R. s. 45</cite> <he>מביאה … נִתְעַבְּרָה</he> she conceived on her first intercourse; <he>אין אשה מִתְעַבֶּרֶת וכ׳</he> no woman conceives on &c.; <cite ref="Yevamot 34a">Yeb. 34ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Yevamot 34b:4">Ib. 34ᵇ</cite> <he>כדי שלא תִתְעַבֵּר וכ׳</he> that she may not become with child, and her beauty &c., v. <cite ref="K00469"><he>כָּחַשׁ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 9:1">B. Kam. IX, 1</cite> <he>ונתעברה אצלו</he>, v. supra; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be extended, to be consolidated into one township. Y. Erub. V, 22ᵇ bot. יכול אני … בית מעון מתעברת וכ׳ I can cause Beth Ma‘on and Tiberias to be considered one township (as regards Sabbath distances).

to be added to, to be proclaimed a full month (of thirty days), a leap-year (of thirteen months). Y. R. Hash. III, beg. 58ᶜ ניסן לא נ׳ מימיו Nisan was never made a full month (by decree of the court); Y. Shebi. X, beg. 39ᵇ; a. e.—
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 12a:4">Snh. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>ראויה … שתִּתְעַבֵּר</he> that year ought to have been a leap-year. B. Mets. <he>נִתְעַבְּרָה השנה נתע׳ לשוכר</he> if the year was made a leap-year, the tenant (that rented by the year) reaps the benefit of the intercalation.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 19b:5">R. Hash. 19ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 10:3">Tosef. B. Kam. X, 3</cite> <he>בהמה ונֶעֶבְרָה בה עבירה</he> if one stole a beast, and some sinful act was committed on it (by which it became forbidden for any benefit); (<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 9:2">B. Kam. IX, 2</cite>, a. fr. <he>נעבדה … עבירה</he>).
